title: Realistic Mochachos conversation: named-item quantity correction mid-order, through to the real persisted order
notes: Real Mochachos item names/prices (Quarter Chicken R59.90, Buddy 440ml R28.90). Both start at quantity 1 (ambiguous by quantity alone), so correcting the Quarter Chicken specifically exercises the new named-item disambiguation in _detect_quantity_correction -- resolved deterministically, through to the final persisted order. Phrasing deliberately avoids intent_router.is_cart_correction's own, separate, pre-existing patterns (e.g. 'actually make it...') -- found while writing this fixture that a message matching BOTH is_cart_correction and the new quantity-correction detector takes the older, pre-existing cart-clear-and-rebuild-via-LLM path, since that check runs earlier in pipeline.py. Not a defect (that path still produces a correct result, just via the LLM rather than deterministically) and not changed here, to avoid altering existing, working, documented behaviour. Also found: the real catalog's 'Buddy' has no alias entry (unlike 'coke'/'cola'/'sprite'), so correcting it by that bare word alone would need the full 'Buddy 440ml' name or the LLM -- noted in WORKLOG.md as a minor, separate, out-of-scope observation, not fixed here.

turns.message: Hi, I'll have a Quarter Chicken, mild, and a Buddy 440ml
no wait, make the quarter chicken 2 instead of 1
